purpose: Teach: 祐/俊/吾/遙/諒/ゆり/綾/朱

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんのお友達の祐さんが今度遊びにいらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father's friend Yuu is coming to visit.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opener. Light, almost sing-song lilt on the name announcement. Relaxed pacing. Tone of gentle inclusion — letting him in on something nice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとお友達の俊くんと公園に行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I went to the park with Dad and his friend Shun.
lines.style: Bright and direct. Small note of pride on 'went'. Natural child speed, a little eager to share. Clean ending — no trailing-off. The simplicity of pure recollection.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「吾輩は猫である、と語る朗読会」を観られたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father watched a reading of 'I Am a Cat.'
lines.style: Calm, almost musing. Slight pause before the title, like she's remembering the detail. Soft, approving tone. Slow pace — this is something she found meaningful about what he did.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとお友達の遙ちゃんに会ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I met Dad's friend Haruka.
lines.style: Eager but controlled. Warm opening on the name. Quick, light pace — the energy of something new and good. No hesitation. Simple pride in the telling.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「諒くんとも仲良くね」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father said to be kind to Ryo too.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, gentle. Light emphasis on 'to be kind' — not lecturing, just passing along what matters. Conversational rhythm. A small, warm instruction wrapped in her tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと従姉妹のゆりちゃんと遊んだよ
lines.en: Mom, I played with Dad and my cousin Yuri.
lines.style: Quick, bright delivery. Small note of warmth on the cousin reference. Natural child enthusiasm — this is a good thing, worth telling. Eager but not breathless.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「綾ちゃんのご家族にもよろしくね」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father said to send his regards to Aya's family.
lines.style: Composed, gentle instruction. Light, warm tone — she's passing along his thoughtfulness. Slow, steady pace. The care in relaying what he said.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと朱色の絵の具で絵を描いたよ
lines.en: Mom, I painted a picture with Dad using red paint.
lines.style: Warm, satisfied closure. Slight visual brightness on 'red' — the color matters to him. Natural, proud child pacing. Soft landing at the end. This is a complete, happy memory.
